answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round. What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
